title: Etale scheme objects are invariant under algebraic-space thickenings
statement: Let $B$ be a scheme and work with algebraic spaces over $B$ [def-trf-algebraic-space] in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], with sheaf fibre products [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. A thickening means a representable closed immersion inducing a homeomorphism on underlying spaces; closed immersions are tested after every scheme base change [def-weil-closed-immersion], and underlying spaces have the quotient topology from a surjective etale scheme atlas [def-a1-space-point-topology]. Let $i:W_0\hookrightarrow W$ be any thickening. For an algebraic space $H$, let $\operatorname{EtSch}(H)$ have as objects schemes $V$ with a representable etale map $V\to H$, and as arrows all morphisms of schemes over $H$. Then base change induces an equivalence of categories $$\operatorname{EtSch}(W)\longrightarrow\operatorname{EtSch}(W_0),\qquad V\longmapsto V\times_W W_0.$$ In particular every etale scheme object over $W_0$ has an etale scheme lift over $W$, and for any two such lifts the map on morphism sets is bijective. No quasi-compactness, separation, finite type, or finite-order hypothesis on the thickening is imposed.

proof.text: For every scheme test $T\to W$, thickening base change makes $W_0\times_WT\to T$ a surjective closed immersion of schemes. The cited scheme lemma therefore makes it integral, universally injective and surjective. Representability is already part of the definition of $i$. All hypotheses of integral-radicial etale invariance hold, so pullback gives an equivalence $F:\operatorname{EtSp}(W)\to\operatorname{EtSp}(W_0)$ of the categories of chartwise etale algebraic-space objects.

proof.text: If $V\to W$ is a scheme object, then $V_0=W_0\times_WV$ is a scheme: the projection $V_0\to V$ is a scheme base change of the representable map $i$. Chartwise etaleness is preserved by base change, and for scheme sources it is equivalent to representable etaleness. Consequently $F(V)$ lies in $\operatorname{EtSch}(W_0)$, and $F$ restricts to the functor in the statement, with its action on arrows given by fibre products.

source.place: Tag 05ZS (lemma-thickening-equivalence), proof using Tag 05ZH (theorem-topological-invariance) and Tag 05ZR (lemma-thickening-scheme).

proof.text: Given $U_0\in\operatorname{EtSch}(W_0)$, essential surjectivity of the ambient equivalence gives a chartwise etale algebraic space $V\to W$ and an isomorphism $V_0=W_0\times_WV\cong U_0$ over $W_0$. Thus $V_0$ is represented by the scheme $U_0$. Thickening base change makes $V_0\hookrightarrow V$ a thickening; the cited thickening-of-a-scheme theorem now shows that $V$ is a scheme. Its chartwise etale structure map is representable etale by the scheme-source clause of etale permanence. Hence $V$ is an object of $\operatorname{EtSch}(W)$ lifting $U_0$. None of these results assumes finite order of the thickening.

source.place: Tag 05ZS (lemma-thickening-equivalence), proof using Tag 05ZH (theorem-topological-invariance) and Tag 05ZR (lemma-thickening-scheme).

proof.text: For schemes $V,V\prime$, Yoneda identifies natural transformations $h_V\to h_{V\prime}$ with scheme morphisms $V\to V\prime$, compatibly with their maps to $W$. Therefore $\operatorname{EtSch}(W)$ is the full subcategory of scheme objects in $\operatorname{EtSp}(W)$, and likewise over $W_0$. The ambient full faithfulness gives precisely the required bijections on their morphism sets. Choose the lifts of step 3 and their reduction isomorphisms. Define an inverse functor on arrows by the unique preimages under these Hom bijections. Uniqueness proves preservation of identities and compositions. The chosen reduction isomorphisms form the counit; lift their inverses to obtain the unit. Naturality and the triangle identities can be checked after the faithful functor $F$, where they are identities. This proves the claimed equivalence and both concluding assertions.
